title: Noise operator contraction
statement: Let $n\ge 0$, $0\le\rho\le1$, and $p\ge1$. For every real-valued function $f$ on the Boolean cube $\{−1,1\}^n$, the uniform $L^p$ norm of its noise-operator image at parameter $\rho$ is at most the uniform $L^p$ norm of $f$.
